product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native diagnostic operating system combining medical-imaging workflow tools and clinical AI for hospitals, radiology groups, and imaging departments.
product_one_liner.notes: Positioned as a full-stack medical imaging/diagnostics platform.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage presents a demo/contact path and no public pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are named in Eden's customer case study.

employee_band.notes: YC lists the team size as 100.

hq_location.notes: YC lists San Francisco as location; Eden's about page additionally describes operational hubs in Mexico City and São Paulo.

eng_blog.notes: The publicly indexed whitepapers/product-guides content is product, clinical research, and user-feature material; it does not show two engineering-authored posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage provides product, research, whitepapers and demo links but no public documentation/help center or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: YC's Eden listing identifies an open Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model role.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product/technology and privacy information; Eden describes its own medical-imaging AI but does not disclose a model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed under Eden's stewardship; FDA, INVIMA and ANVISA are also displayed there but are not included because they are not among the requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: Reported Eden Series A of $22 million in October 2025. A Sierra Ventures post describes its earlier $10 million investment in July 2024.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 Series A falls within the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current AI research role is discoverable, but no sufficiently verifiable complete current job board listing was found to establish whether sales development or AE roles are open.

launched_6mo.notes: The public whitepapers index is readable but did not provide reliable dates for its newest launch-type items, and no dated post within the six-month window could be verified.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team/about page is not sufficient to establish a complete dated leadership roster, and no dated C-suite or VP join/departure announcement was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The available product pages and job result checked did not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system.
